case.summary: Alert HHG-012 was triggered by an elevated legacy real-time risk score of 0.55 on transaction 3553342 for $30.91 on card C05876-K2. The bank's calibrated second-generation fraud model evaluated the purchase with a score of 0.008, reflecting an expected historical fraud rate of only 0.006. A review of 106 card transactions across the 14-day window demonstrated consistent in-person retail spending with no testing patterns or suspicious velocity. Furthermore, billing region 494 shows an exculpatory fraud lift of 0.3, and the card has no association with any active fraud ring. The transaction represents legitimate cardholder spending, and the alert is resolved as a false alarm.
